Course

Verifying hardware with t27: testbenches, waveforms, formal, mutation

For a reader who has a design and wants to trust it. Every lesson opens a real verification tool built from real runs on our bench: read a little, then break something on purpose.

27 lessons, one working widget and one t27 spec each: testbenches that check themselves, waveforms, vectors, cosimulation with the board, coverage, assertions, mutation, and a sign-off you can show.
